title: Insertion sort returns a permutation of its input
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type and let $\mathit{xs}$ be a list of elements of $\alpha$. Then the list produced by insertion sort applied to $\mathit{xs}$ is a permutation of $\mathit{xs}$.
hypotheses_covered: α is a linearly ordered type
xs is a list over α
replaced: The list returned by the timed insertion sort of $\mathit{xs}$ is a permutation of $\mathit{xs}$.
